tiles.name: Debug Path
tiles.description: Semi-transparent cyan/blue overlay marker indicating pathfinding route. Soft glow effect for visibility.

tiles.name: Debug Target
tiles.description: Bright target marker with concentric rings or crosshair pattern. High-contrast color for easy spotting.

tiles.name: Floor
tiles.description: Basic floor tile used as fallback. Visually identical to dirt.

tiles.name: Dirt
tiles.description: Medium brown packed earth with subtle texture variation. Dry, compacted surface with occasional small pebbles.

tiles.name: Wall
tiles.description: Gray stone brick wall with mortar lines visible. Weathered surface with slight color variation between bricks.

tiles.name: Stone
tiles.description: Solid gray stone block with rough-hewn surface texture. Natural stone coloring with subtle veining.

tiles.name: Glass Wall
tiles.description: Transparent glass panel with subtle blue-green tint. Smooth reflective surface with visible frame edges.

tiles.name: Grass
tiles.description: Lush green grass with short, even blades. Bright spring-green coloring with natural variation.

tiles.name: Tall Grass
tiles.description: Tall swaying grass blades in yellow-green tones. Wispy tips catching light, dense at base.

tiles.name: Wildflowers
tiles.description: Scattered wildflowers in pink, yellow, and white amid green grass. Small delicate blooms.

tiles.name: Fertile Soil
tiles.description: Rich dark brown tilled soil with visible furrows. Moist appearance with organic matter visible.

tiles.name: Dirt Path
tiles.description: Worn tan dirt path with packed earth surface. Lighter colored than surrounding terrain, well-traveled.

tiles.name: Small Rock
tiles.description: Small gray-brown fieldstone with rounded edges. Natural weathered appearance, partially embedded in ground.

tiles.name: Boulder
tiles.description: Large gray granite boulder with lichen patches. Rough weathered surface, imposing presence.

tiles.name: Shrub
tiles.description: Dense green bush with small oval leaves. Rounded dome shape, healthy vibrant foliage.

tiles.name: Forest Floor
tiles.description: Dark brown forest floor with scattered twigs and decomposing leaves. Dappled texture, rich organic matter.

tiles.name: Mossy Ground
tiles.description: Thick green moss carpet covering ground. Soft velvety texture in deep emerald tones with patches of darker shade.

tiles.name: Fallen Leaves
tiles.description: Scattered autumn leaves in orange, red, and brown hues. Crisp dry texture, randomly overlapping.

tiles.name: Undergrowth
tiles.description: Low dense ferns and small plants in dark green. Tangled growth with broad fronds.

tiles.name: Tree
tiles.description: Tall deciduous tree with brown bark and full green canopy. Thick trunk, spreading branches above.

tiles.name: Dense Trees
tiles.description: Cluster of tall trees forming dense canopy. Multiple overlapping green crowns, minimal gaps between.

tiles.name: Fallen Log
tiles.description: Horizontal brown tree trunk lying on ground. Weathered bark with moss patches, decaying ends.

tiles.name: Mushroom Patch
tiles.description: Cluster of red-capped mushrooms with white spots. Small toadstools in fairy-tale style grouping.

tiles.name: Tree Stump
tiles.description: Cut tree stump showing growth rings. Flat top surface, brown bark around edges, weathered gray center.

tiles.name: Sand
tiles.description: Golden-tan desert sand with fine granular texture. Soft rippled patterns from wind, warm yellow tones.

tiles.name: Sand Dune
tiles.description: Rolling sand dune with smooth curved surface. Light golden color with subtle shadow on lee side.

tiles.name: Cracked Earth
tiles.description: Dried cracked earth in pale tan and gray. Deep fissures forming irregular polygon pattern, parched appearance.

tiles.name: Gravel
tiles.description: Loose gray and brown pebbles covering ground. Mixed stone sizes, rough irregular texture.

tiles.name: Desert Rock
tiles.description: Sun-bleached tan rock formation with wind erosion marks. Smooth rounded edges from sandblasting.

tiles.name: Rocky Outcrop
tiles.description: Tall jagged rock formation in orange-brown sandstone. Layered sedimentary bands visible, dramatic silhouette.

tiles.name: Cactus
tiles.description: Tall green saguaro cactus with vertical ribs and spines. Classic desert silhouette with upward-reaching arms.

tiles.name: Bleached Bones
tiles.description: Scattered sun-bleached white bones on sand. Dry brittle remains, stark contrast against tan ground.

tiles.name: Animal Skull
tiles.description: Large weathered animal skull in ivory white. Horned or antlered, partially buried in sand.

tiles.name: Snow
tiles.description: Fresh white snow with soft powdery texture. Pristine crystalline surface with subtle blue shadows.

tiles.name: Packed Snow
tiles.description: Compacted white snow with harder crusty surface. Slightly grayer than fresh snow, ice crystal sheen.

tiles.name: Frosted Ground
tiles.description: Ground with white frost crystals forming feathery patterns. Pale blue-white ice formations on surface.

tiles.name: Permafrost
tiles.description: Frozen gray-brown earth with ice veins visible. Hard solid surface mixing soil and permanent ice.

tiles.name: Ice Path
tiles.description: Smooth translucent ice surface reflecting light. Clear pale blue with slight cloudiness from air bubbles.

tiles.name: Ice Block
tiles.description: Large chunk of pale blue glacial ice. Semi-transparent crystalline structure with sharp angular edges.

tiles.name: Frozen Rock
tiles.description: Dark gray boulder encased in ice and frost. White frost crystals covering surface, frozen in place.

tiles.name: Evergreen Tree
tiles.description: Dark green pine or spruce tree with snow on branches. Conical shape, dense needle foliage.

tiles.name: Frozen Lake
tiles.description: Flat frozen water surface in pale blue-white. Smooth ice sheet with occasional cracks visible.

tiles.name: Snowdrift
tiles.description: Piled snow mound formed by wind. White curved surface with smooth windswept contours.

tiles.name: Mud
tiles.description: Wet dark brown mud with glossy sheen. Soft squelchy texture with standing water patches.

tiles.name: Shallow Water
tiles.description: Murky greenish-brown shallow water. Partially opaque with visible mud bottom, stagnant appearance.

tiles.name: Reed Bed
tiles.description: Tall brown and green cattails and reeds in shallow water. Thin vertical stalks with fluffy seed heads.

tiles.name: Swamp Moss
tiles.description: Spanish moss in gray-green draping strands. Stringy hanging texture with aged weathered look.

tiles.name: Peat
tiles.description: Dark brown-black peat bog surface. Spongy organic material with visible decomposed plant matter.

tiles.name: Murky Pool
tiles.description: Dark stagnant pool with opaque black-green water. Oily surface sheen, unknowable depth.

tiles.name: Dead Tree
tiles.description: Skeletal gray dead tree with bare twisted branches. Bark peeling, stark silhouette against sky.

tiles.name: Gnarled Roots
tiles.description: Exposed twisted tree roots in dark brown. Knobby tangled mass rising from swamp water.

tiles.name: Lily Pads
tiles.description: Round green lily pads floating on water. Flat circular leaves with white or pink flower buds.

tiles.name: Fog Hollow
tiles.description: Low-lying white-gray mist obscuring ground. Ethereal foggy haze creating eerie atmosphere.

tiles.name: Rock
tiles.description: Gray-brown natural stone surface with rough texture. Solid bedrock appearance with weathered cracks.

tiles.name: Slate
tiles.description: Dark blue-gray slate rock with layered flat surfaces. Smooth planes at slight angles, fissile texture.

tiles.name: Scree
tiles.description: Loose angular rock fragments in gray and brown. Unstable slope debris with sharp edges.

tiles.name: Cliff Face
tiles.description: Sheer vertical rock wall in dark gray granite. Jagged ledges and crevices, imposing height.

tiles.name: Mountain Boulder
tiles.description: Large irregular gray boulder with rough surface. Massive rounded rock with lichen and weathering.

tiles.name: Ore Deposit
tiles.description: Rock outcrop with metallic ore veins visible. Gray stone with shiny copper or iron deposits showing.

tiles.name: Alpine Shrub
tiles.description: Hardy low-growing shrub in muted green. Compact wind-sculpted shape, small tough leaves.

tiles.name: Cave Entrance
tiles.description: Dark cave opening in rock face. Shadowy arch entrance with rough stone framing, mysterious interior.

tiles.name: Shallow Water
tiles.description: Clear light blue shallow water with visible sandy bottom. Gentle ripples, transparent enough to see through.

tiles.name: Deep Water
tiles.description: Dark blue deep water with no visible bottom. Rich navy blue color, surface reflections only.

tiles.name: Sandy Shore
tiles.description: Pale golden sand at water's edge. Wet near waterline, dry further up, smooth beach texture.

tiles.name: Rapids
tiles.description: Rushing white water over rocks. Churning foam and spray, energetic blue-white turbulence.

tiles.name: Coral Reef
tiles.description: Colorful coral formations in pink, orange, and purple. Branching structures underwater, vibrant reef life.

tiles.name: Seaweed
tiles.description: Flowing green-brown kelp and seaweed. Long wavy fronds swaying with current, aquatic vegetation.

tiles.name: Submerged Rock
tiles.description: Dark gray rock visible beneath water surface. Rounded from erosion, algae-covered, hazard marker.

tiles.name: Cave Floor
tiles.description: Dark gray stone floor with smooth, worn surface. Dusty texture with subtle moisture sheen, cool tones.

tiles.name: Cave Rubble
tiles.description: Scattered gray stone fragments and debris. Irregular chunks of broken rock, dusty surface with sharp edges.

tiles.name: Glowing Moss
tiles.description: Soft bioluminescent moss emitting pale blue-green glow. Fuzzy texture, patches of light on dark stone background.

tiles.name: Wet Cave Floor
tiles.description: Damp stone floor with visible water film. Dark gray with reflective wet sheen, small puddles forming.

tiles.name: Cave Wall
tiles.description: Solid dark gray rock wall with rough, uneven surface. Dense stone with mineral veins, impenetrable barrier.

tiles.name: Stalactite
tiles.description: Conical stone formation hanging from ceiling. Gray-brown with mineral deposits, pointed tip, wet dripping surface.

tiles.name: Crystal Formation
tiles.description: Translucent crystal cluster with geometric facets. Pale purple or blue hues, glittering surface, natural gem formation.

tiles.name: Cave Boulder
tiles.description: Large rounded stone mass. Dark gray with smooth weathered surface, massive obstacle blocking passage.

tiles.name: Lava Pool
tiles.description: Molten rock pool glowing bright orange-red. Rippling liquid surface with darker cooling crust patches, intense heat shimmer.

tiles.name: Magma Vent
tiles.description: Rocky fissure with glowing magma visible below. Dark stone edges, orange-yellow glow emanating upward, sulfurous steam.

tiles.name: Lava
tiles.description: Hardened black lava with rough cracked surface. Dark gray to charcoal coloring, rope-like patterns, porous texture.

tiles.name: Obsidian
tiles.description: Smooth black volcanic glass with mirror-like sheen. Deep glossy black, sharp conchoidal fractures, reflective surface.

tiles.name: Volcanic Ash
tiles.description: Fine gray powder covering the ground. Pale gray with dusty texture, light particles suspended in air, desolate appearance.

tiles.name: Volcanic Rock
tiles.description: Dark porous ignite rock with irregular surface. Black to dark red coloring, vesicular texture with small holes, jagged edges.

tiles.name: Lava Cracks
tiles.description: Dark stone surface with glowing orange fissures. Black rock with web-like cracks, magma visible through splits, heat emanating.

tiles.name: Enchanted Grass
tiles.description: Luminescent grass blades in shifting purple and teal hues. Magical glow at tips, ethereal shimmer, otherworldly coloring.

tiles.name: Rune Circle
tiles.description: Glowing arcane symbols in circular pattern. Golden or blue light traces on stone, geometric precision, pulsing magical energy.

tiles.name: Crystal Spire
tiles.description: Tall crystalline tower with faceted surface. Brilliant amethyst purple, internal light source, geometric pointed structure.

tiles.name: Void Rift
tiles.description: Tear in reality showing swirling darkness. Deep purple-black void with scattered stars, unstable edges crackling with energy.

tiles.name: Mana Pool
tiles.description: Shimmering liquid pool of pure magical essence. Brilliant cyan-blue glow, perfectly still surface, radiant light from within.

tiles.name: Arcane Glyph
tiles.description: Single glowing magical symbol etched into ground. Soft white or gold light, intricate curved lines, mystical ancient script.
